command: set -u; S=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; PID=$(systemctl --user show $S -p MainPID --value); echo SERVICE=$S; echo PID=$PID; systemctl --user show $S -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p StateChangeTimestamp --no-pager; echo ===PS===; ps -p $PID -o pid=,ppid=,etimes=,stat=,cmd= || true; echo ===NETWORK===; if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -tpn 2>/dev/null | grep -F "pid=$PID," || echo NO_ESTABLISHED_SOCKET_FOR_PID; else echo SS_UNAVAILABLE; fi; echo ===FD_SOCKETS===; find /proc/$PID/fd -maxdepth 1 -lname 'socket:*' -printf '%l\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true; echo ===RECENT_JOURNAL_180S===; journalctl --user -u $S --since '-180 seconds' --no-pager -o short-iso 2>/dev/null | tail -160 || true; echo ===CLIENT===; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; echo VOICE_IDLE_BOUNDARY_PREFLIGHT_DONE
